fields.label: Passport Number
fields.helpText: Enter your passport number exactly as printed (e.g., AB1234567)

fields.label: Surname (Family Name)
fields.helpText: As printed on your passport — all caps

fields.label: Given Name(s)
fields.helpText: As printed on your passport

fields.label: Passport Expiry Date
fields.helpText: Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from your entry date

fields.label: Country of Passport Issuance
fields.helpText: The country that issued your passport

fields.label: Email Address
fields.helpText: This is your K-ETA account email — you'll receive your approval notice here

fields.label: Mobile Phone Number
fields.helpText: Include country code (e.g., +1 for US)

fields.label: Home Address
fields.helpText: Your permanent home address

fields.label: Intended Duration of Stay (days)
fields.helpText: Maximum 90 days per visit for most visa-exempt nationals

fields.label: Flight Number
fields.helpText: e.g., KE001 or OZ201

fields.label: Airline
fields.helpText: Search by airline name or IATA code (e.g. KE, OZ, SQ)

fields.label: Port of Entry (Airport)
fields.helpText: Incheon (ICN) handles most international flights; Gimpo (GMP) for some regional routes

fields.label: Country of Departure
fields.helpText: The country where you board your flight to Korea

fields.label: Accommodation Name
fields.helpText: Hotel, hostel, guesthouse, or private address where you will stay

fields.label: Accommodation Address
fields.helpText: Full Korean address including city and postal code

fields.label: Do you currently have fever, cough, shortness of breath, or other respiratory symptoms?
fields.helpText: Answer truthfully — false declarations may result in penalties

fields.label: Have you been diagnosed with or treated for a communicable disease in the past 30 days?
Have you visited any area with an active infectious disease outbreak in the past 21 days?
fields.helpText: Areas designated as high-risk by the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)

fields.label: Are you carrying any prohibited or restricted items? (narcotics, firearms, etc.)
fields.helpText: Prohibited items include narcotics, psychotropic substances, firearms, explosives, and counterfeit goods

fields.label: Are you carrying goods with a total value exceeding USD 800 (approx. KRW 1,000,000)?
fields.helpText: Korea's duty-free allowance is USD 800. Items exceeding this limit must be declared and may be subject to customs duties.

fields.label: Are you carrying currency or monetary instruments exceeding USD 10,000 (or equivalent)?
fields.helpText: Includes cash, traveller's cheques, and other monetary instruments in any currency

fields.label: Are you carrying any animals, plants, fresh fruits, vegetables, or animal/plant products?
fields.helpText: Korea strictly controls agricultural and animal imports to prevent disease. Declare all such items.

fields.label: Are you carrying commercial goods, samples, or goods intended for sale or distribution?
Are you carrying any prescription medications or controlled substances for personal use?
fields.helpText: Bring a copy of your prescription. Some medications legal in your country may be controlled in Korea.

submissionGuide.title: Create Your K-ETA Account
submissionGuide.description: Visit the K-ETA portal at k-eta.go.kr and create an account using your email address. Each traveler must have their own account.
tips: Use an email you will have access to while traveling — approval notice is sent here
Keep your login credentials safe; you'll need them to check your application status
Apply at least 72 hours before your departure — processing can take up to 72 hours

submissionGuide.title: Enter Passport Details
submissionGuide.description: Enter your passport information exactly as it appears on your passport.
tips: Double-check your passport number — errors can cause denial at immigration
Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months from your planned entry date
Names must match your passport exactly, including any hyphens or special characters

submissionGuide.title: Personal Information
submissionGuide.description: Provide your contact details and personal background information.
tips: Use the same email as your K-ETA account for consistency
Select the occupation category that best matches your current status
Include your full residential address, not a P.O. box

submissionGuide.title: Travel Details
submissionGuide.description: Enter your trip information including your flight, intended stay, and entry point.
tips: Most international flights arrive at Incheon International Airport (ICN)
Select the purpose that best matches your primary reason for visiting
If connecting through Korea, select 'Transit' as your purpose

submissionGuide.title: Accommodation in Korea
submissionGuide.description: Provide the address and details of where you will be staying in South Korea.
tips: If staying at multiple places, enter the first accommodation
Airbnb and private rentals are accepted — enter the full address
Hotel confirmation emails include the complete Korean address

submissionGuide.title: Health Declaration
submissionGuide.description: Answer the health screening questions required for entry into South Korea.
tips: Answer honestly — false health declarations are a criminal offense
If you answer 'Yes', you may be subject to additional health screening upon arrival
Conditions change; check the KDCA website for current health advisories

submissionGuide.title: Customs Declaration
submissionGuide.description: Declare any goods, cash, or items that may be subject to customs regulations.
tips: Korea's duty-free limit is USD 800 per person — gifts and souvenirs count toward this total
Strict penalties apply for undeclared currency exceeding USD 10,000
Korean Customs has strict biosecurity rules — declare all food, plant, and animal items
For prescription medications, carry a letter from your doctor and original packaging

submissionGuide.title: Submit & Await Approval
submissionGuide.description: Review all your information, pay the K-ETA fee (if applicable), and submit. You will receive an approval notice by email within 72 hours.
tips: K-ETA approval is typically granted within 72 hours but can be shorter
Save or screenshot your approval notice — present it at check-in and immigration
K-ETA is valid for 2 years (or until your passport expires) and covers multiple entries
If denied, you may need to apply for a visa at your nearest Korean embassy
